fields.description: The fields to include in the response.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of permissions to return per page (1–100).

pageToken.description: The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page.

supportsAllDrives.description: Whether the request supports both My Drives and shared drives.

useDomainAdminAccess.description: Issue the request as a domain administrator.

includePermissionsForView.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response.
